@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: The status notes that float over the transcript have the glass of the status line (TestudoApp D213)
+---
+## What
+The Testudo user says: "the message where we show 'the agent is ready' in the chat is hovering above, and needs to be glass -- right now it is just transparent and blends together". TestudoApp decision D213 (`/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/TestudoApp/features/decisions.md`, row D213) records the rule. It changes D110 (b), D122 (c) and D123 for floating notes only. Testudo card 01M84XCWE0RH8SGJ0K8HB945V0.
+
+Facts:
+- Each note is a `StatusBar` (`Sources/AgentViewKitStyle/Status/StatusBar.swift`, near lines 251-256). It has only an edge line and no fill.
+- In `Sources/AgentViewKit/Thread/AgentThreadView.swift` (near lines 458-530), only the status line and the composer have glass. The transcript scrolls under the notes (`SessionStreamBanner` in the top bar, `StateBanner` in the bottom bar), so its text shows through.
+
+Work:
+- [ ] Each note that floats over the transcript (`StateBanner`, `SessionStreamBanner`, and the other banners of the top bar and the bottom bar) uses the same glass material as the status line. The glass is in one `GlassEffectContainer` with the composer or the status line where they touch. No glass on glass.
+- [ ] The text is readable over any content, in light and dark appearance. With Reduce Transparency, the note has an opaque background.
+- [ ] A status text that does not float (for example in a list or an inspector) keeps no glass. Thus the glass is a choice of the place, not of every `StatusBar`.
+- [ ] Give a public modifier or style that a host uses to match the look for its own floating notes (Testudo `AppNoticeBanners`). Report its name.
+- [ ] Gallery screens: transcript text under the top and the bottom notes, in light and dark, and one screen with Reduce Transparency.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] In the new gallery screens, transcript text under a note does not show through the note in light and dark appearance.
+- [ ] In the Reduce Transparency screen, the note background is opaque.
+- [ ] A `StatusBar` that does not float has no glass.
+- [ ] The public modifier or style exists, and the host can apply it.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Unit test first (fails before the fix): a floating `StatusBar` gets the glass style, and a `StatusBar` that does not float gets none (for example, read an environment value or a style value with a slot probe, as `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Thread/ThreadHeaderTests.swift` does).
+- [ ] `swift test` in the root: all pass, no code warnings.
+- [ ] `HOME=<temp> swift test --package-path ScreenshotTests`: all pass. Give the PNG paths of the new screens.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #d213
\ No newline at end of file

+    - `StatusBar` in `.floating`: `.floatingGlass()` of EditorStyle (the glass of the status line), no separator stroke, and `.editorButtonSurface(.glass)` inside, so its button is bordered (no glass on glass). This inner surface wins over the `.content` surface that the banners declare.

The test now reads the edge of each banner from that frame (gap = tile margin, 8). The dead helpers `explanationHeight`, `disconnectedExplanation`, `explanationMeasureWidth` and the unused `EditorSwiftUI` import are removed.
